headline: Q4 organic growth of 1% slightly beat forecasts, but FY sales fell and Arnault warned 2026 'won't be simple'; shares -7.9%.
guidance_note: No numeric guidance; Arnault cautious, calling the 2026 environment disrupted and unforeseeable.
key_messages: Fashion & Leather Goods -3% organic in Q4, -5% for 2025.
Wines & Spirits -5% organic for 2025, profit -25% on weak cognac and US-China trade tensions; no Q4 figure found.
Selective Retailing +4% organic for 2025 with profit +28% led by Sephora.
FY2025 revenue EUR 80.8B (-1% organic, -5% reported); US 26% of revenue, grew on solid local demand.

consumer.big_ticket: US saw growth on solid local demand; Europe declined in H2.
consumer.pricing: Trade tensions between the US and China hurt cognac.

macro_read: Global luxury was flat-to-weak into 2026; the US was a relative bright spot but not a strong engine.
notes: Group organic growth is shown because sources disagree on the U.S. figure for this quarter (flat vs +1%).
LVMH is listed in Paris and reports in euros. It does not file with the SEC, so this card is refreshed on request, not automatically.
Revenue shown is Q4 2025; FY2025 revenue EUR 80.8B.
The stock move shown is for 2026-01-28 (first Paris session after the after-close release), per CNBC.
Q4 reported YoY change not confirmed.
